title: Project Management MVP SQLite Schema Proposal
description: Normalized relational schema for one Kanban board per user in the MVP, extensible to multiple users and boards.

database.initialization: Create the database file and tables on application startup if they do not exist. Seed the MVP user and board only when absent.
database.transactions: Read-modify-write board mutations in a single transaction. Roll back the complete mutation on validation or persistence failure.

users.purpose: Application users and future ownership boundary.

boards.purpose: A user's Kanban board. The MVP permits one row per user.

columns.purpose: Ordered stages belonging to a board.

cards.purpose: Card content, independent of its current stage.

board_cards.purpose: Associates each card with one column and stores its order within that column.

invariants: Every board belongs to exactly one user.
Every column belongs to exactly one board.
Every card belongs to exactly one board and has exactly one board_cards membership row.
A card's board, column's board, and board_cards membership must refer to the same board.
Positions are zero-based and ordered within their parent collection.
The MVP seeds five columns and eight cards for the user named user, with the current demo ordering.
API responses must not expose records belonging to another user.

write_rules: Create and edit card content in cards and its board_cards membership in one transaction.
Rename a column by updating columns.title.
Move a card by updating board_cards.column_id and normalizing affected positions.
Delete a card by deleting cards; board_cards is removed by cascade.

seed.credentials: The password remains an application-level MVP credential and is not stored in this proposal as a database field.
